status: proposed: F02 submitted, not accepted. Every message class is a proposal with classification_status pending_G5. Every number in this file is proposed, not approved. Repair attempt 2 (design review A6D-01, A6D-07): PSC-3 now cites the runtime gate FF-RUN-1/FF-RUN-2 held in runtime_gate, and E09 alternate_class lists marketing_dispatch as data. Repair attempt 3 (design review A6D2-02): already_booked and already_rebooked count only bookings joined to the contact (authority-matrix.md AM-BOOK-3 to AM-BOOK-6), and E15 and E16 are created only for a joined booking.
classification_rule: Operational versus promotional is decided by the G5 reviewer from the message's actual content and purpose (04 §6, 05 §8), never from the template name or from using a provider's 'transactional' API. If G5 reclassifies a template, this file and the delivery-job template-to-class rules change together in a new contract version.

provider_daily_quota.note: Transactional and marketing sends share the same credits. Not verifiable from the build container (egress 403, D-057). P05 records the account's actual quota and resets it here if different.

quota_window.interim_rule: Until P05 records the provider's quota day and its time zone, count sends in a rolling 24-hour window, which is never looser than a calendar day.

hard_stop.rule: No automated send once 280 sends are counted in the window. The 20-send margin covers operator notices and sends made outside the dispatcher on the same account.

soft_daily_budget.rule: Below this, operational and promotional jobs are both eligible, within their pools.

operational_reserved.rule: Capacity promotional jobs can never use.

promotional_max.rule: soft_daily_budget minus operational_reserved. Promotional jobs stop at this count even if operational demand is low.

approval.owner: Arnaud (send budget, G2) with the privacy and operations owner (G5)

budget.counting_rule: Every send through the Brevo account counts, whatever its origin: dispatcher jobs, operator notices, SM01 smoke sends and staging allowlist sends if staging shares the account. Messages sent by the scheduling provider itself (a possible E15 sender) do not count against Brevo.
spill_rules: BUD-1: The dispatcher claims due jobs in ascending priority, then ascending due_at. Operational jobs (0-3) are always claimed before promotional jobs (5-9).
BUD-2: When the promotional count reaches promotional_max, promotional jobs are released with defer_reason daily_budget and next_attempt_at at the next window. The deferral is not an attempt.
BUD-3: Operational jobs may continue past operational_reserved up to soft_daily_budget, then up to hard_stop with an operator alert (N09).
BUD-4: At hard_stop every job is deferred with defer_reason daily_budget. A deferral never extends expires_at, so a reminder that cannot be sent in time expires; it is never sent late.
BUD-5: A provider 429 or quota error moves the job to retry_due (last_error rate_limited or quota_exhausted) and pauses promotional claims for the rest of the window.

frequency_caps.rule: At most one acquisition nurture message (E03, E04, E05, E11) per contact per 48 hours. A later job is deferred (defer_reason frequency_cap), not dropped, and still expires on time.
No promotional message to a contact on a calendar day (America/Toronto) on which an E07 or E08 is due to that contact. Defer with defer_reason reminder_collision.
frequency_caps.status: proposed (04 §6 collision rule; there is no newsletter template in E01-E16)

forecast.formula: peak_operational = 2 x R + G + B + M + K

definitions.R: registrants of every event whose E07 or E08 falls in the same window
definitions.G: expected guide (E01) plus workshop access (E10) requests on that day
definitions.B: book messages (E12, E13, E14) on that day, bounded by the book unit cap (proposed 8, HB-20)
definitions.M: meeting messages (E15, E16) sent through Brevo on that day
definitions.K: operator notices and smoke or staging sends on the same account

forecast.rule: Before an event is scheduled, compute peak_operational for its busiest day. If it exceeds operational_reserved, lower the registration cap (HB-17) or ask Arnaud for an upgrade decision (G2, HB-08). The meeting room's participant limit is never the email budget (04 §6).

priority_scale.rule: Lower number first. The delivery-job schema enforces operational <= 3 and promotional >= 5.

anchors.consent.effective_at: captured_at of the consent_events row whose state is granted for the purpose (after confirmation when double opt-in is used)
anchors.webinar.replay_available_at: set by the operator only when the G4 replay policy allows a replay; unset means no E09

offset_notation: ISO 8601 durations. A leading '-' means before the anchor (for example -PT1H is one hour before).

suppression_codes.consent_missing: promotional job with no current granted consent for its purpose at the pre-send check
suppression_codes.consent_withdrawn: latest consent_events row for the purpose is revoked
suppression_codes.provider_blocklist: Brevo reports the address blocked, unsubscribed or hard-bounced; applies to every class
suppression_codes.contact_suppressed: contact lifecycle_state is suppressed or erased
suppression_codes.already_booked: the contact has a confirmed future booking joined to it by the exact-address rule (authority-matrix.md AM-BOOK-3), or such a meeting held within the suppression window (window pending G5). meeting.confirmed applies it to pending and retry_due jobs (T3) and the pre-send check applies it to a leased job (T5). A booking that matches no contact suppresses nothing until the operator joins it (AM-BOOK-5, AM-BOOK-6)
suppression_codes.client_flag: client_flag set by Bill or an authorized operator (never inferred from a purchase)
suppression_codes.human_reply: a meaningful reply paused acquisition and created one human task (WF07)
suppression_codes.event_remade: the event was remade with a new date; its old jobs stop and new jobs follow the new event
suppression_codes.entitlement_inactive: the consultation right is not active (used, void or expired)
suppression_codes.already_rebooked: a new confirmed booking joined to the same contact (AM-BOOK-3) exists after the cancellation
suppression_codes.not_allowlisted: outside production, the recipient is not on the G2 recipient allowlist

common_pre_send_checks: PSC-1: run after the lease is acquired and before send_started_at is recorded, never only at queue time (N02 acceptance)
PSC-2: now < expires_at, otherwise the job becomes expired

PSC-3: the runtime gate is open (feature-flags.md FF-RUN-1 and FF-RUN-2; data in runtime_gate below): the capability that owns the template is enabled; each of its controlling flags is true, except that outside production public_launch and checkout_live are replaced by the environment substitute (not production, reviewer-only access, the recipient allowlisted as PSC-5 checks, Stripe in test mode); and every promotional job, whatever capability owns it and in every environment, also needs marketing_dispatch true. Otherwise release with defer_reason capability_disabled
PSC-4: the provider blocklist and contact lifecycle allow the send
PSC-5: outside production the recipient is on the allowlist
PSC-6: the class's budget pool and the frequency caps allow the send, otherwise defer
PSC-7: template_version is still the approved hash for the job's locale

runtime_gate.defined_in: feature-flags.md section 5.1; applied by job-state-machine.md section 6 step 2 and PSC-3
runtime_gate.capability_rule: The owning capability's enabled state is true and every one of its controlling flags is true, except the flags listed in nonproduction_substitutes when the environment is not production.

public_launch: access limited to reviewers (existing proxy.ts review protection, since launchApproved() is false) or a local development machine
every send goes only to a G2-allowlisted recipient (PSC-5, suppression not_allowlisted)
checkout_live: Stripe uses test-mode credentials; a live-mode key refuses to start the capability
every send goes only to a G2-allowlisted recipient (PSC-5, suppression not_allowlisted)

runtime_gate.class_flags_rule: A job's class adds these flags in every environment, whatever capability owns the template. They are never substituted outside production.
runtime_gate.consistency: The nonproduction_substitutes keys equal the flags feature-flags.json waives for enabled outside production (FF-INV-1); validate_f02_data.py section 7 checks it.
